run_dense_eval_hybrid: run the dense_eval script to compute AdsorbML hybrid ML+DFT success rates at varying top-k values
run_dense_eval_ml_only: run the dense_eval script with --ml-success to compute validated ML-only success rates
compute_hybrid_success: compute AdsorbML hybrid success rates and DFT compute usage for top-k ML predicted structures
compute_valid_ml_success: compute validated ML success rates by comparing ML energies within 0.1 eV of DFT energies
filter_ml_data: filter ML data by setting missing systems or configs to high energy values for failure evaluation
